title: Filters compose: only invoices matching ALL active filters contribute anywhere
preconditions: 1. ZZAUTOTEST invoices exist that each fail exactly one of: date range, product type, invoice status, location — plus one invoice matching all four.
steps: 1. Set all four filters (a range, "Parts only," "Paid," one location).
2. Read the rep rows, counts, detail rows, and the grand Totals indicator.
expected: 1. Only the invoice matching ALL active filters contributes — every metric reflects the intersection.
2. A rep appears only if at least one invoice matches all of them.
3. Each invoice failing any single filter contributes nothing anywhere.
